title: Exquisite Steamed Turkish Milk Kazandibi
description: A traditional Turkish dessert featuring a creamy milk pudding topped with a caramelized sugar crust, known for its umami flavor and springy texture, often consumed as a hangover cure.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the milk, sugar, and cornstarch, whisking until the cornstarch is dissolved.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the vanilla extract.
Strain the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of granulated sugar over the top of the pudding.
Caramelize the sugar by using a kitchen torch to carefully burn the sugar in a circular motion.
Alternatively, place the dish under the broiler for 1-2 minutes, or until the sugar is golden brown.
Serve the kazandibi chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon if desired.
